_doc: Registry of the wiki dashboards hub (_dashboards/index.html). HAND-EDIT this file; the page is derived by _tools/build_dashboards_hub.py (last step of refresh_features.py).
cadence: daily | weekly | ondemand | explainer | archive  (one section each, in that order).

sections[].kicker: short eyebrow above the section title, also the sub-line of its overview tile. routine: the job that rebuilds the file (shown on the card). topic: free-text chip. asof: optional fixed date for snapshots (otherwise the file mtime is shown).
type: 'file' for non-HTML downloads (pptx/xlsx). subhub: true = the page links its own sibling files, so the unregistered-file scan skips that folder.
Every .html on disk that is not listed here (and not in ignore/) is surfaced in an 'Unregistered' section so a new dashboard never goes invisible again.
Stale rule: daily cards older than stale.daily.business_days, weekly cards older than stale.weekly.days. On-demand / explainer / archive are never stale.

cards.title: The Light Path — OCS · CPO · scale-up/out — versão Claude
cards.desc: Interactive 3D explainer: how an optical circuit switch re-routes light with MEMS mirrors (vs an electrical switch), how optics move from pluggable to NPO to CPO (power, pJ/bit, DSP, laser, service), where copper, pluggables, NPO, CPO and OCS sit in scale-up vs scale-out (NVL72 → NVL576 walkthrough), and a 'Who sits where' map of every company the wiki places in each layer — every number attributed.

cards.title: The Wafer Path — TSMC logic · DRAM · HBM — versão Claude
cards.desc: Interactive 3D explainer with a step-by-step walkthrough per tab: how TSMC builds a leading-edge logic wafer (FinFET → GAA → backside power, the EUV/DUV patterning loop, tools and capex per fab), how the memory makers build a DRAM wafer (1T1C, 6F² → 4F² VCT → 3D DRAM, where the few EUV layers sit) and what turns DRAM dies into an HBM stack (TSVs, base die at TSMC, MR-MUF vs TC-NCF vs hybrid bonding, yield compounding, wafer trade ratio) — every number attributed.

cards.title: The Trade Ratio — one wafer, two fates (DDR vs HBM) — versão Claude
cards.desc: Interactive 3D sketch in six build-it-up steps with a 'Walk me through it' mode: one 300 mm wafer → 16Gb DDR dies → the same wafer as HBM core dies (TSV field) → TSV loss and known-good dies → 12-high stacking with compounding yield → count the bits (Micron's 3:1 → ~4:1 trade ratio). Editable example, KPI strip, share-vs-bits chart, sourced cards; visual companion to the MU wafers-to-bits workbook.

cards.title: The Token Path — one prompt across many GPUs — versão Claude
cards.desc: Interactive 3D companion to The Light Path: a 7-step walk of one prompt (head node, weight sharding, prefill/KV cache, decode all-to-all, the spill from NVL72 to NVL576 and scale-up optics, the agent loop, where the light is) driven by a live memory calculator on sourced constants, every number attributed.

cards.title: The Laser Line — how Lumentum makes an EML — versão Claude
cards.desc: Interactive 3D production line in a studio view with an editable wafer-diameter example (3/4/6-inch → chips/month, revenue, share of Citi's 2028E supply), a diameter comparison chart and a who-does-what layer per station (suppliers, sites, peers, buyers, end customer). Sulfur-doped InP wafer → MOCVD epitaxy → DFB grating + EAM → wafer fab → probe → bars, facets, AR/HR → dice, submount, test → transceiver or NVIDIA's external laser source — every number attributed.
